name: Signs Foundation Damage Is Getting Worse

mainEntity.name: What signs mean foundation damage is getting worse?
mainEntity.text: What signs mean foundation damage is getting worse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Worsening foundation damage usually shows up as changing symptoms, not just the presence of cracks. If cracks are getting wider, longer, or appearing in new areas, the structure may still be moving. Other warning signs include doors and windows that suddenly stick, floors that feel more uneven, separations at trim or cabinets, and gaps between walls, ceilings, or floors. In Los Angeles County, repeated cycles of moisture change, slope issues, or seismic movement can make the condition worse over time. If damage progresses after previous patching or cosmetic repair, that is a strong sign that the original cause was not fixed. A contractor should document whether the movement is active and whether monitoring or stabilization is needed quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation damage is likely getting worse when cracks widen, doors and windows stick more often, floors slope further, gaps open between walls and ceilings, or new cracks appear after repair. In Los Angeles County, repeated movement can happen after rain, drought, or seismic activity. Worsening symptoms usually mean the structure is still moving and needs evaluation.
